description: Use this when the person asks to change Pugi logos already shown in this conversation: other colours, a calmer or bolder mood, another icon or font, "like the second one but blue". Draws four new options from the same brief with that change, without asking anything; it does not edit one chosen design. Pass exactly one of logo_id (from the last logo result) or question_token (from the logo card). Do not use for a different business name (use make_logo).

change.description: The change in the person's own words, for example "make it blue and calmer".

idempotency_key.description: A unique string for this call, reused only to retry it.

language.description: The language the person writes in, as a BCP 47 tag such as "ru".

logo_id.description: The logo_id of one of the logos to change, from the last logo result (the picked one when there is one). Leave it out when you pass question_token.

question_token.description: The question_token of the logo card, when you have no logo_id. Leave it out when you pass logo_id.

name: refine_logo
title: Change the logos
